sentences.text: Esta mañana Rosa fue al mercado con su hija Marta.
sentences.english: This morning Rosa went to the market with her daughter Marta.

sentences.text: Tenían que comprar frutas y verduras para la semana.
sentences.english: They had to buy fruit and vegetables for the week.

sentences.text: En el mercado había mucha gente.
sentences.english: There were many people at the market.

sentences.text: Rosa vio a una vendedora y le dijo:
sentences.english: Rosa saw a seller and said to her:

sentences.text: La vendedora tenía naranjas, plátanos y tomates.
sentences.english: The seller had oranges, bananas and tomatoes.
"How many oranges do you want?" asked the seller.

sentences.text: —Quiero diez naranjas y seis plátanos —dijo Rosa.
sentences.english: "I want ten oranges and six bananas," said Rosa.

sentences.text: La vendedora puso las naranjas en una bolsa y se las dio a Rosa.
sentences.english: The seller put the oranges in a bag and gave them to Rosa.

sentences.text: Rosa pagó y dio las gracias.
sentences.english: Rosa paid and said thank you.

sentences.text: Marta tenía hambre y quería un plátano.
sentences.english: Marta was hungry and wanted a banana.
"Mom, will you give me a banana?" she asked.

sentences.text: Rosa le dio un plátano y Marta se lo comió.
sentences.english: Rosa gave her a banana and Marta ate it.

sentences.text: Después Rosa compró tomates y cebollas.
sentences.english: Then Rosa bought tomatoes and onions.

sentences.text: Volvieron a casa con las bolsas.
sentences.english: They went back home with the bags.

sentences.text: En casa, Rosa dijo: —Voy a hacer una sopa.
sentences.english: At home, Rosa said, "I'm going to make a soup."
"Great, I'm going to help you!" said Marta.
